name: visual-explainer-codex
description: Generate polished, self-contained HTML explanations for code, architecture, plans, diffs, slides, and data.

interface.shortDescription: Turn technical context into polished HTML visual explanations
interface.longDescription: Visual Explainer creates self-contained HTML diagrams, reports, diff reviews, plan reviews, project recaps, slide decks, and data tables. Its Codex skill provides a design system and reusable templates; the bundled MCP server adds Gemini image generation tools for banners, icons, and patterns.
defaultPrompt: Create a polished visual explanation of this architecture
Turn this diff into a self-contained HTML review
Build a high-fidelity slide deck from this topic
